rationale.text: A visible iframe has a title attribute with an empty value. The test asks for a title attribute, which is present, while the glossary defines the frame title as the content of that attribute; the text does not say whether an empty one meets the test. The custom check answers cannot_tell (step 2); only the record supports this branch. axe's frame-title faults an empty title, through an evidence-only link, so the reason at full is alternative_unresolved; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.
